definitions.explanation: A person whose job is to sell products, typically in a retail store. A neutral, professional term for someone working in sales.

examples.japanese: {販売員|はんばいいん}に{聞|き}いてみよう。
デパートの{販売員|はんばいいん}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work as a salesperson at a department store.

examples.japanese: {親切|しんせつ}な{販売員|はんばいいん}が{商品|しょうひん}の{特徴|とくちょう}を{丁寧|ていねい}に{説明|せつめい}してくれた。
examples.english: A friendly salesperson carefully explained the features of the product.

notes: A compound of {販売|はんばい} (selling) + {員|いん} (member, staff). More formal and professional than {店員|てんいん} (shop staff), which is the everyday word for a store clerk. {販売員|はんばいいん} is commonly used in job listings and business contexts. Related terms: {営業|えいぎょう}マン (salesman, more business-to-business), {店員|てんいん} (shop clerk, everyday).
